items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: What's the largest band you ever played with other than the WPA? ... Papi Solastain. ... Twelve pieces. ... That time I was playing music, I'd be hitting the roads

ctx.x: If a number is played and I don't know it, I'll feel around for it a little bit. And then most second choruses, I'm most assured that eventually I will get it. Of course, I have a good year. I can write, I can read music.
I can read music. What's the largest band you ever played with other than the WPA? Well, by both bands, folk. Papi Solastain. How big a band would he have?

Twelve pieces. Twelve pieces and an entertainer. And where would he work with Twelve Pieces? Oh, out of town mostly. That time I was playing music, I'd be hitting the roads, you know what I mean. And he was a man that would get Boyk. He was one of the ones, he was actually one of the ones. He would get Boyk all over. Go to a lot of town sometimes for his, Pensacola.
